name: Trigueros (Spain)
description: A red hoist stripe and a fly of three horizontal stripes of yellow, red and green, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Trigueros (ears of wheat, a castle and a lion within a wreath).
history: Municipal flag of Trigueros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
